verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime is a banking-as-a-service API platform covering accounts, KYC, ACH/wire/FedNow transfers, cards and webhooks. It is not an agent or AI host that consumes external tools, so acting as an MCP client is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any MCP-client or tool-plugin capability that would make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
